note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 45; A06b Const 45; L05 Const 49(1)(b), 49(1)(c)): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A01b (descent, born abroad: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from the father only, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Eswatini, 2024
sources.said: Person is ordinarily resident for at least 12 months prior to aplication and 5 years during the previous 7 years. ... n.a. ... Person has shown himself by any overt act other than marriage to have acquired another citizenship, or person has by any voluntary act other than marriage acquired another citizenship. ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born in Eswatini to a father who is a citizen, or to a mother who is a citizen and the father does not adopt or claim the child. ... Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply) ... Person is born abroad to a father who is a citizen who was born in the country, or to a mother who is a citizen who was born in the country and the father does not adopt or claim the child, and the person notifies desire to retain citizenship within 1 year after reaching age of majority. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to a father who is a citizen who was born in the country, or to a mother who is a citizen who was born in the country and the father does not adopt or claim the child, and the person notifies desire to retain citizenship within 1 year after reaching age of majority.
